title: Amendment CV to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina
text:
Emerika Bluma 1, 71000 Sarajevo
Tel. 28 35 00 Fax. 28 35 01

AMENDMENT CV
TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE
FEDERATION OF BOSNIA AND
HERZEGOVINA
“Official Gazette of the Federation of Bosnia and
Herzegovina”, 33/04
NOTE: Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina was published in the “Official
Gazette of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina”, 1/94.

Pursuant to Amendment I, paragraph (2) to the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia
and Herzegovina, at the session of the House of Representatives, held on 25 May 2004,
and the session of the House of Peoples, held on 2 May 2004, the Parliament of the
Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina enacted the following
AMENDMENT CV
TO THE CONSTITUTION OF THE FEDERATION OF
BOSNIA AND HERZEGOVINA
In the Constitution of the Federation of Bosnia and Herzegovina, in Article VI.7.2, the
word “cantons” shall be deleted.
Chair Chair
of the House of Peoples of the House of Representatives
of the BiH Federation Parliament of the BiH Federation Parliament
Slavko Matić, manu proprio Muhamed Ibrahimović, manu proprio
